payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of state-of-the-art baselines in the context of text-to-SQL generation, including models and their adaptations.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines include Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, which are adapted for context-dependent SQL generation.
Recent advancements in state-of-the-art performance include models that utilize recursive decoding and graph neural networks for encoding schemas.
The proposed editing mechanism improves generation quality over previous state-of-the-art baselines by reusing previous SQL query results.
The SParC dataset serves as a benchmark for evaluating state-of-the-art models in context-dependent semantic parsing.
